source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of language editors (PDF 29).

blocks.text: Language editors, jinhein code editors bhi kehte hain, woh tools hain jo developers ko mukhtalif programming languages mein code likhne aur edit karne mein madad dete hain. In ka maqsad code likhne ke liye aasan (user-friendly) interface dena hai. Misalein:

items: Notepad++: saada lekin taqatwar code editor.
Sublime Text: apni tezi aur aasan istemal ki wajah se mashhoor.
VS Code: mashhoor editor jis ki bohat si extensions (izafi features) hain.

blocks.prompt: Language editor ka maqsad kya hai? Do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Code likhne aur edit karne ke liye aasan interface dena. Misalein: Notepad++, Sublime Text, VS Code (koi do).

items: Language (code) editors: code likhne ka aasan interface; Notepad++, Sublime Text, VS Code.
